description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Applied Intuition builds technology for physical AI. The Software Engineer will develop products, features, and tools for customers’ autonomy workflows, work with large-scale data processing systems, and collaborate across infrastructure, robotics, graphics, and the autonomy ecosystem.
Software Engineer building full-stack products and tools for autonomy development, with large-scale data processing for analysis

Responsibilities:
• Contribute across the full technology stack to design and implement new products, features, and tools that enhance customers' autonomy development workflows
• Work with large-scale data processing systems to support data-driven development and analysis
• Collaborate with experts in infrastructure, robotics, and graphics, as well as experienced startup professionals, while also engaging with the broader autonomy ecosystem to understand diverse approaches to solving fundamental challenges
• Carve out a specialized area of expertise, influence key product decisions, and grow through cross disciplinary collaboration

Requirements:
• Must have at least a Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or a related field
• 18 months of experience in a software engineering role for a technology company
• At least 1 year of experience with the following: Programming Languages: Golang, C++, SQL
• At least 1 year of experience with the following: Databases: MySQL, Redis
• At least 1 year of experience with the following: Messaging & Event Systems: Apache Kafka, RocketMQ
• At least 1 year of experience with the following: Frameworks & Tools: gRPC, Thrift, Kitex, Protobuf
• At least 1 year of experience with the following: Cloud / Infrastructure: GCP, OCI
• At least 1 year of experience with the following: CI/CD: Unit testing, Integration testing, Stress testing, Grafana
